openWrangler.artifactKind: development VSIX; not a qualified release candidate

method.clockStart: Immediately before submitting the selected file path with Enter (final Open action). Prior command and path selection, installation and trust setup are untimed.
method.gridReadyMs: Correct active product tab, expected full row and column counts, unfiltered view, and located ID 0 and ID 1 cells.
method.interactiveMs: After grid readiness, a new click on ID 1 produces the expected selected cell.
method.threeHeadersReadyMs: Fully visible id, amount and category header profiles have expected missing/distinct counts and completed distributions, with numeric ranges and 20 bins for the numeric headers.
method.completeAmountStatsMs: Expected statistics are available in the rendered selected-column summary; includes selection, panel reveal and any bottom-panel closing actions since final Open. Some Data Wrangler statistics require scrolling at 1280 by 900; scrolling to lower statistics is excluded from this endpoint.
method.otherTimingFields: First amount statistics, selection-relative intervals and return-to-amount display are separately retained as recorded.
method.startupAndCacheLimit: Fresh editor per observation with the prepared profile; source-hash checks warm file caches. This does not establish that runtime preparation starts after the Open clock or that storage is cold.
method.workDifference: Data Wrangler additionally displays quartiles, kurtosis and skew. Matching periodic-fixture statistics do not establish identical scan scope or work.

preparation.inputVerification: Every serialized cell, row order, missing counts and amount aggregates checked before collection.
